chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding

the man who comes performing Umrah, the exclusive Umrah. He (peace be upon him) said: It suffices him if he performs Tawaf around the House, and Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and shaves (his head), that he performs one Tawaf around the House; and whoever wishes to shorten (his hair), he shortens.

key_terms.حَلَقَ: Shaving (the head, as a ritual act of completion)
key_terms.عُمْرَةً مَبْتُولَةً: Exclusive Umrah (Umrah performed independently, not combined with Hajj)
key_terms.قَصَّرَ: Shortening (the hair, an alternative to shaving)

ai.seo_question: What are the required rituals to complete an exclusive Umrah according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the minimal requirements for Umrah al-Mufradah, establishing that a single circuit of Tawaf and Sa'i, followed by halq or qasr, suffices for validity. It highlights the flexibility in the ritual's completion, allowing the pilgrim to choose between shaving the head or merely shortening the hair, a distinction often discussed in Shia fiqh regarding the perfection of the rite. The hadith underscores the practical ease granted to pilgrims, reinforcing the principle that the core pillars are met with these essential actions.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding

the man who comes to perform Umra, the exclusive Umra. Heasws said: ‘It would suffice him when he performs Tawaaf and performs Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and shaves off (his head) if he performs one Tawaaf by the House, and the one who so desires that he shortens (his hair), shortens’.
en.sarwar: 6. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about

a man who is for al-‘Umrah al-Mabtulah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is sufficient for him to perform Tawaf around the House, Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and shave, if he has performed one Tawaf around the House, and if he likes, he can do Taqsir (cutting some hair or finger nails and so on).”’
